purpose: Independent source-grounded D12 mechanism mapping; not execution or Gate evidence

original_gold_test.scope: Only asserts 202 count, unique references, legal result-code coverage and prohibited-effects shape; does not execute each referenced D12 case

constraints.window_adjudication: Preserve original source. Use all supported source events inside frozen120sec and separately test outside-boundary exclusion. Never change runtime120sec to300sec.
constraints.directory: Existing Mock/Deferred/Faulting directory port only; no external directory or hospital master-index integration.
constraints.monitoring: Pure trusted-input contract only; no fabricated normal-ingress monitoring authority or new connector.
constraints.normal_chain: Frame -> Inbox/Intake -> Worker -> actual DB effects. No seeded successful Decision/Ticket/Candidate.
constraints.mechanism_chain: Setup real prerequisites through owning commands; may inject declared fault or directory stub, never construct outcome under test.
constraints.metrics: 64 mechanisms are not64 independent natural-language classification successes. Track per-surface execution and explicit semantic adjudication; do not count enum validation as runtime safe-route coverage.

cases.description: 群内@Bot并直接描述明确故障
cases.trusted_preconditions: Fresh approved group and Reporter; original fault text in real Frame.
cases.required_execution_and_invariants: Assert durable Inbox/Intake before Worker; Ticket1, group-origin Journey/Leg; inspect safe receipt/guidance actions and actual queued effects.
cases.adjudication_and_no_shortcut: Do not seed a TICKET_ELIGIBLE output. Source two-notification suggestion is policy context; actual mandatory effects require docs51/Direct-Leg adjudication.

cases.description: 群内只@Bot不描述

cases.required_execution_and_invariants: Assert Intake persists, no Ticket, guided mode and exactly one reachable clarification/manual fallback; preserve group origin.
cases.adjudication_and_no_shortcut: Do not inject EMPTY/NEEDS_DESCRIPTION.

cases.description: 用户主动单聊发起报修

cases.required_execution_and_invariants: Original printer-jam Frame creates Direct Organic Journey and minimal Ticket; no fabricated group/ref.
cases.adjudication_and_no_shortcut: Do not prebind a group or create Direct Leg solely to admit first inbound.

cases.description: 重复群回调只形成一个Journey

cases.required_execution_and_invariants: Real Inbox replay; one Journey; compare Message/Outbox/Delivery deltas and no duplicate send.
cases.adjudication_and_no_shortcut: Keep identical provider identity and msgid; changing msgid does not test replay.

cases.description: 群内未@Bot的普通聊天不触发机器人入口

cases.description: 单聊用户连续分三条描述
